title: The Drifting Island
text: An island of earth and grass floats past in the dark, trailing roots like a jellyfish. A single tree grows on it, heavy with pale fruit. It is close enough to jump to, for now, and drifting slowly away into nothing.

options.label: Jump to it before it drifts away, and see where it carries you.

outcomes.text: It carries you a long way through the dark, then sets you down gently, as if it knew where you were going.
It carries you somewhere you did not mean to go, then drifts off without a goodbye.

options.label: The quickest leaps over, grabs the fruit, and leaps back before it is too far.

outcomes.text: The fruit glows. It tastes of a home none of you have seen.

options.label: Watch it go. Not everything that drifts by is meant to be boarded.

outcomes.text: As it drifts away, something on it stands up and waves. It keeps waving until it is gone.
